summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Central Park Brass, a brass quintet formed in 2002. Its purpose is to perform an annual series of brass chamber music concerts in New York City's Central Park. The note is brief and contains no further details on membership, history or repertoire.
one_line: Central Park Brass is a brass quintet formed in 2002 that performs an annual brass chamber music concert series in New York City's Central Park.
